visual_review: Diagonal hammer: a rectangular head block (2.25:1) across the handle, the handle leaving the middle of its face at a right angle to the corner; exact 45-degree geometry. The near-square head of the reference/before read as a swatter or sign, the block reads as a hammer at 48 in both themes.
omissions: The reference's near-square head proportion, lengthened into a block so it reads as a hammer.
